questions.question: Why did Saul become jealous of David?
options: David had fled from Saul's army in battle
David was much older and stood next in line for the throne
David had grown far richer than the king
The women sang that David had slain his ten thousands
questions.answer: The women sang that David had slain his ten thousands

questions.question: Who loved David as his own soul and made a covenant with him?
Saul tried to kill David by throwing a spear at him.
The women sang, "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten _____."
_____, Saul's son, loved David and made a covenant with him.
